summary: First-principles design review, iteration 14 (full record in review_loop/scrutiny_14.md). The headline claim, confirmatory family, matched-k design, and SS0.1 framing were re-examined and stand. This pass executed iteration 13's named worklist (phases.py transition machinery, nli_server.py device/dtype, final CLI-vs-docs check) with MEASUREMENT rather than reading -- every claim checked against the 2,184 logged pilot actions and 79 trajectory transcripts -- and found three genuine mechanism-integrity defects in the run path, all fixed and stage-tested before any confirmatory GPU hours are spent. (T1, major, fixed) Context truncation (first-4 + last-40 messages past 80) silently dropped the assigned-strategy prompt: 3 of 79 pilot trajectories ran long and their final transcripts no longer contain 'YOUR ASSIGNED STRATEGY' -- exactly the hard instances could drift back to the model's mode, diluting the treatment mechanism the paper describes; _truncate_context now pins '## Current Phase:' user messages (idempotent, <=2 messages of cost, symmetric across arms since the vanilla arm's generic patch prompt and VERIFY submit protocol are pinned identically). (T2, major, fixed) The SEARCH read-only boundary -- load-bearing because strategy forks replay search MESSAGES into fresh containers rather than cloning the searched filesystem, so a SEARCH write would desync t0's starting state from every fork's -- was enforced only by a prefix allowlist that 'echo fix > file.py', 'cat <<EOF > f.py', and even the submission command sailed through (the VERIFY-only submission special case was dead code below the prefix loop); is_command_allowed now decides submission first and vetoes SEARCH writes with is_write_command (measured: 0/189 pilot SEARCH actions affected -- the guard converts an assumed invariant into an enforced one at zero behavioral cost). (T3, major, fixed) The write detector -- the SDLG arm's once-per-instance branch-point trigger -- false-positived on comparison operators inside quoted programs (awk 'NR>=350...': 2/2,184 pilot actions; a false positive before the first real write moves the whole instance's branch point to a view step) and structurally missed writes in non-final && segments (sed -i ... && pytest); is_write_command v2 strips heredoc bodies, blanks quoted spans, and inspects every top-level segment; validated by diffing old-vs-new verdicts over all 2,184 pilot actions (exactly 9 changes, each inspected: 2 FPs removed, 7 chained patch-prep redirects now consistent with their already-True unchained forms). Two smaller fixes: dead SEARCH branch of detect_phase_transition removed with honest enforcement docs (only SEARCH is enforced; PATCH/VERIFY allowlists are prompt-level guidance; the SEARCH_PROMPT's 'STRATEGY: transitions you' sentence is a nudge, with saturation as the real exit), and nli.py's degenerate-input early return now carries its full schema (the /sdlg_scores endpoint KeyError'd on it; dead in the live path). One spec amendment applied (R8.1 strengthened to name the quoted-program/chained-segment detection classes, the enforced SEARCH boundary, submission-first ordering, and document-unenforced-boundaries -- tripwire-clean: R8.1 was pass and the strengthened bar is met by this same iteration's work). Estimator stack fifth spot-check, this time brute force: pass_at_k == exhaustive hypergeometric for all n<=8; expected_distinct_at_k == exhaustive subset enumeration with duplicates and empty patches; exact sign-flip == full 2^10 enumeration with the 2^(1+z-n) floor attained. 144 tests pass (139 -> 144), py_compile clean, campaign dry-run plan unchanged, work committed. Generalizing lesson (P3): an ASSUMED invariant is not yet a guarded one -- the fork design's correctness rested on a code comment, the mechanism's potency on an instruction staying in context, the detector's precision on commands looking like their last segment. Because this iteration found and fixed real run-path defects, gold_standard_met is FALSE per the charter; iteration 15 should sweep the clone/injection layer (branching_agent.inject_and_execute, docker_helpers.clone_container_state, TrajectoryManager.save_all), strategy_proposer parse robustness, and a final config-vs-defaults sweep.

R1_faithfulness.notes: The branch-point trigger's 2 measured false-positive classes are closed before the SDLG arm ever runs; agent-loop faithfulness docs now match enforcement.

R3_ablations.notes: The write-detector fix improves SDLG-arm attribution (R3.1 mechanism purity) without touching the strategy arm's branch logic.

issues_found.title: Context truncation silently dropped the assigned-strategy prompt (and could drop the VERIFY submit protocol): _truncate_context kept first-4 + last-40 messages, and the PATCH_PROMPT_WITH_STRATEGY message sits in the dropped middle -- measured on 3 of 79 pilot trajectories, exactly the long/hard instances where mode-collapse pressure matters; the treatment mechanism the paper describes ('each fork independently implements its assigned strategy') was silently false for them
issues_found.rationale: Phase prompts ('## Current Phase:') are now pinned across truncation, idempotently, at <=2 messages of cost; symmetric across arms (the vanilla arm's generic patch prompt and submit protocol are pinned identically). Direction honestly analyzed (M2): restores the documented mechanism, touches no metric/matching/endpoint, disclosed in RESULTS SS2.1. Test pins both the survival and the re-truncation case.

issues_found.title: SEARCH read-only boundary unenforced: the prefix allowlist admitted redirect writes (echo/cat with '>') and the submission command in ANY phase (the VERIFY-only special case was dead code below the prefix loop) -- while fork-state consistency load-bearingly assumes SEARCH never modifies files (forks replay messages into fresh containers, not filesystem clones)
issues_found.rationale: is_command_allowed now decides submission first (VERIFY-only) and vetoes SEARCH writes via is_write_command; the orchestrator's existing blocked-command handler (error message + low-relevance scoring) covers the new vetoes so blocked loops still saturate. Measured zero occurrences in 189 pilot SEARCH actions -- the guard is purely protective. Residual python -c programmatic writes documented as undetectable.

issues_found.title: Write detector (SDLG branch-point trigger) misclassified: false positives on comparison operators inside quoted awk/python programs (2/2,184 pilot actions -- a false positive before the first real write corrupts that instance's SDLG branch point, since SDLG fires once) and false negatives for writes in non-final && segments (sed -i ... && pytest)
issues_found.rationale: is_write_command v2: heredoc bodies stripped, quoted spans blanked, every top-level &&/;/newline segment inspected. Validated by diffing old-vs-new over all 2,184 pilot actions: exactly 9 verdict changes, each inspected (2 FPs removed; 7 chained patch-prep redirects now consistent with their already-True unchained forms -- the documented scratch-file limitation applied uniformly). R8.1 strengthened to name these classes (applied_14).

issues_found.title: detect_phase_transition carried an unreachable SEARCH branch keyed on 'STRATEGY:' phrases (SEARCH->PATCH is decided solely by should_end_search saturation/cap), and the phases.py docstring implied three enforced phase boundaries when only SEARCH is checked by the orchestrator
issues_found.rationale: Dead branch removed (same class as iteration 13's has_strategy); module docstring rewritten with the honest enforcement contract including why VERIFY cannot be read-only (submit protocol requires git diff > patch.txt) and that the SEARCH_PROMPT's transition sentence is a behavioral nudge, not a wired trigger.

issues_found.title: nli.py compute_sdlg_scores degenerate-input early return violated its own documented schema (missing gradients/embeddings/token_ids/word_starts), which the /sdlg_scores server endpoint indexes directly -> HTTP 500 on empty/whitespace text
issues_found.rationale: Early return now carries the full schema. Dead in the live path (the SDLG generator uses /sdlg_rank, which guards on empty tokens; the local fallback also guards) -- fixed as a latent contract violation, not a live bug.

changes_made.why: T2/T3/T4: the SDLG branch point and the load-bearing SEARCH read-only invariant get real guards; docs stop implying unenforced boundaries.
